0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat and Minnesota Timberwolves open their 2026-27 seasons, with Keshad Johnson (hamstring) out for Miami and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) out for Minnesota. The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Heat a 50% chance of winning.
